controls.scope: Public restore and shared computation doctor on controlled metadata copies; negative target/source/snapshot immutability, two restore roundtrips on positives. No raw extraction/provider/full gate.

static_review: Scratch validation runs before target table/view removal, before migration and after migration; parent and layout failures cannot enter target replacement.

Known frozen BatchRequest hash is verified with or without receipt. Intent receipt binds actual retained request/context; submitted metadata checks known SHA without rebuilding context from receiver/text after cleanup.

Known selection/artifact/extraction IDs validate indexed JSON fields, exact source part/body/text/count and present selection-artifact/extraction junctions. No inferred legacy parent or fake unknown value.
Adapter uses typed models/SQLite only; no service dependency, new DDL, writes or BaseException suppression. Doctor and restore share the same closed diagnostics.
merge_barrier: Apply only guard adapter + import/pre/post scratch hooks and doctor input-check additions. Preserve Root26e modern RowFactory, current/memo writers, modern-ref counts/validation and primary-projection restore checks; never replace whole stale sqlite_repo/computation_doctor files.
initial_harness_corrections: First execution assumed unknown-only doctor must be recorded (correct is not_run/zero errors), and consumed items were listed by an unconsumed-only API. Corrected only independent driver; original attempt retained. No product failure or source repair.
